name: power-bi-dedicated
description: Deploys an Azure Power BI Dedicated capacity using the AVM-backed module.
what: A Power BI Dedicated capacity resource (Microsoft.PowerBIDedicated/capacities) for reserved analytics compute with configurable SKU and admin membership.
why: Teams that need predictable, dedicated Power BI compute can provision a governed capacity consistently across environments with IaC.
potentialUseCases: Provisioning a dedicated Power BI capacity for departmental BI workloads
Standing up production-grade Power BI compute with repeatable IaC
Separating dev and prod BI capacity profiles using parameter files

reliability: Consistent resource provisioning via environment parameters
security: Admin member identities are explicit and parameterized
No embedded credentials in template code
costOptimization: SKU and capacity units are configurable
Dev and prod parameters separate sizing choices
operationalExcellence: Single deployment template with standard outputs
performanceEfficiency: Scale SKU tiers from A1 to A6 based on demand
Adjust capacity units without template rewrites

quota.summary: Power BI Dedicated capacity availability and quota vary by subscription and region.

requirements.detail: Ensure your subscription can create the requested Power BI Dedicated SKU in the target region.

components.name: Power BI Embedded A1 node
components.notes: One A1 node x 730 hours. A higher A-SKU or more capacity units rescales this; pause the capacity to stop billing.
